d: Stellar systems and worlds featured in Andy Weir’s Project Hail Mary.

gaia-2452378776434477184.x: Only nearby star immune to Astrophage dimming; destination of the Hail Mary and Blip-A.

tau-ceti-e.x: Super-Earth in Tau Ceti where Ryland Grace and Rocky harvest natural Astrophage predators (Taumoeba).

gaia-3195919528989223040.x: Home system of Rocky and the Eridian civilization aboard the Blip-A.

b.s: Hard science-fiction novel in which solar-dimming Astrophage infects local stars within ~20 light-years of Sol except Tau Ceti, prompting humanity to launch the Hail Mary while the Eridian civilization launches the Blip-A from 40 Eridani.
